title: beta-Hairpin Fold Peptide Brush Polymers.
authors: Oktawiec, Julia; Nadeem, Hassan; Ebrahim, Omar M; Chen, Yu; Barbut, Clara; Byrnes, James; Thompson, Matthew P; Shukla, Diwakar; Gianneschi, Nathan C
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究含beta-hairpin肽的刷状聚合物的结构，结合MD模拟揭示聚合物骨架对肽二级结构的去稳定作用，虽对象为合成聚合物而非天然蛋白，但结构-计算分析框架对蛋白构象设计有借鉴意义。
abstract: Peptide-brush polymers prepared via graft-through polymerization of peptide-based olefinic monomers form Protein-Like Polymers (PLPs) with demonstrated utility as chemical biology tools for modulating intracellular protein-protein interactions and are in development as a emerging class of therapeutic. This favorable bioactivity has been achieved in part by mimicking some of the structural and functional features of proteins, such as their dynamic, globular solution-phase structures, ability to insert into lipid membranes and enter cells, and tendency to enforce alpha-helicity in peptide side chains. However, because structure leads to function, insight into the structure of these proteomimetic polymers, particularly their overall tertiary structure and the extent to which this influences the brush peptide structure, is incomplete. To further this understanding, we prepared a set of brush polymers incorporating the trpzip2 peptide sequence, commonly used as a model system for protein folding. We examine these polymers via circular dichroism spectroscopy, infrared spectroscopy, and small-angle X-ray scattering, coupled with insights from molecular dynamics simulations. Here, a loss of the beta-hairpin structure of the monomer is observed regardless of polymer composition, and simulations corroborate that the polymer backbone destabilizes local secondary structure, restricting peptide motion and altering the accessible free-energy landscape. This study provides insight into design rules governing these synthetic polymer-based proteomimetics.
abstract_zh: 通过接枝聚合肽基烯烃单体制备的肽刷聚合物形成了类蛋白聚合物 (Protein-Like Polymers, PLPs)，已证明可作为化学生物学工具用于调节细胞内蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用，并正在开发为一类新兴的治疗药物。这种良好的生物活性部分是通过模拟蛋白质的某些结构和功能特征实现的，例如其动态的球状溶液相结构、插入脂质膜并进入细胞的能力，以及在肽侧链中强制形成α-螺旋的倾向。然而，由于结构决定功能，对这些拟蛋白聚合物的结构，特别是其整体三级结构以及其对刷状肽结构影响程度的认识尚不完整。为了进一步推进这一理解，我们制备了一组掺入trpzip2肽序列的刷状聚合物，该序列常用作蛋白质折叠的模型系统。我们通过圆二色光谱、红外光谱和小角X射线散射对这些聚合物进行研究，并结合分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟的见解。在此，无论聚合物组成如何，均观察到单体β-发夹结构的丧失，模拟结果证实聚合物主链使局部二级结构失稳，限制肽的运动并改变可及的自由能景观。本研究为 governing 这些基于合成聚合物的拟蛋白模拟物的设计规则提供了见解。
